_note: Institution-wide / faculty-level international tuition, for universities that publish no per-programme figure. feeScope mirrors englishScope: it records the granularity of the number so an institution-wide maximum is never read as a programme's own fee. feeBasis is copied verbatim from the source's own wording — Waterloo bills per TERM, and deriving an annual figure from it would be our arithmetic, not the university's statement.

range.note: varies by faculty/programme; Engineering and Optometry are assessed differently

University of Waterloo.sourceTitle: Fee Schedule for International Undergraduate Students Fall 2026
University of Waterloo.sourceQuote: Fees below are for Fall 2026 term only. ... University of Waterloo bills students one term at a time: fall term - September to December, winter term - January to April, spring term - May to August. With the exception of Engineering and Optometry programs, tuition is assessed for each 0.5-unit course.
University of Waterloo.derivationWarning: Annual cost depends on how many terms the student is enrolled (regular study is 2 academic terms; co-op sequences differ). The university does not publish an annual international figure on this page, so no annual value is stored.

Univ of New Brunswick.finding: No international tuition table is published as HTML. The money-matters and financial-services pages are navigation shells carrying no dollar figures, and UNB routes prospective students to a JavaScript tuition calculator at https://es.unb.ca/apps/tuition-calculator/ which computes per-student amounts rather than publishing a schedule.
Univ of New Brunswick.action: All 130 UNB programmes keep feeVerified:false. No figure fabricated.
